chapter.v:
Jacob called
his sons together, and said, “Gather round so I can tell you what's going to happen to you in the future.

Come here,
sons of Jacob, and listen to Israel your father.

Reuben, you
are my firstborn, conceived when I was strong, born when I was vigorous! You were above all others in position, above all others in power.

But you
boil over like water, so you won't be above anyone anymore, because you went and slept with my concubine; you violated my marriage bed.

Simeon and
Levi are two of the same kind—they use their weapons for destructive violence.

I refuse
to be part of their decisions; I refuse to participate in what they do. For they killed men in their anger; they crippled cattle just for fun.

I curse
their anger because it is too harsh; I curse their fury because it is too cruel! I will separate their descendants throughout Jacob; I will scatter them throughout Israel.

Judah, your
brothers will praise you. You will defeat your enemies. Your father's sons shall bow down to you in respect.

My son
Judah is a young lion coming back from eating its prey. He crouches and lies down like a lion. Like a lion, who would dare to disturb him?

Judah will
always hold the scepter, and the staff of authority will always be at his feet until Shiloh comes; the nations will obey him.

He ties
his donkey to the vine, his donkey's colt to the best vine. He washes his clothes in wine, his robes in the red juice of grapes.

His eyes
sparkle more than wine, and his teeth are whiter than milk.

Zebulun will
live on the seashore and provide a harbor for ships; his territory will extend towards Sidon.

Issachar is
a strong donkey, lying down between two saddle bags.

He sees
that the place where he's resting is good, and the land is lovely, so he's willing to lower his back to accept the burden and to work as a slave.

Dan will
judge his people as one of the tribes of Israel.

Dan will
be as dangerous as a snake beside the road, a viper by the path that bites the horse's heel, throwing its rider off backwards.

I trust
in you to save me, Lord.

Raiders will
attack Gad, but he will attack their heels.

Asher will
have delicious food—he'll produce fancy food for royalty.

Naphtali is
a deer that's free to run; it gives birth to beautiful fawns.

Joseph is
a fruitful tree, a fruitful tree beside a spring, whose branches climb over the wall.

The archers
viciously attacked him; they shot their arrows at him with hate.

But he
held his bow steady, and his arms and hands moved quickly in the strength of the Mighty One of Jacob, who is called the Shepherd, the Rock of Israel.

The God
of your father will help you and the Almighty will bless you with blessings from the heavens above, with blessings from the depths below, with blessings for many children.

The blessings
your father received were greater than the blessings of his forefathers, more than the blessings of the eternal mountains. May they be upon the head of Joseph, on the forehead of the one set apart as a leader from his brothers.

Benjamin is
a vicious wolf. In the morning he destroys his enemies, in the evening he divides the loot.”

These are
all of the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father told them as he blessed them, each according to their respective blessings.

Then he
gave them the following instructions: “I'm going to die soon. Bury me with my forefathers in the cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite.

This is
the cave in the field of Machpelah, near Mamre in Canaan, that Abraham bought together with the field from Ephron the Hittite to own as a burial site.

Abraham and
his wife Sarah were buried there, Isaac and his wife Rebekah were buried there, and I buried Leah there.

The field
and the cave were bought from the Hittites.”

When Jacob
finished giving these instructions he pulled up his feet into the bed, breathed his last, and joined his forefathers in death.
